note: Issue 449, contacts.md section 3: every acknowledgement says what happened, and none describes an outcome the sim did not carry out. A tax rate carried out in part moves a share of the way, and he names the share.

body.text: Your instruction on the duty has been carried out in part. I have moved the rate {param:share} parts in a hundred of the way you asked, and no further.
The whole of it was not possible, and I judged a part better than a quarrel.
